title: gramen rubrum
intro: Gramen rubrum, commonly known as Red Clover, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. The plant is rich in isoflavones, particularly genistein and daidzein, which have been associated with various health benefits, including reducing the risk of heart disease, osteoporosis, and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover, including its isoflavones and flavonoids, exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogen-modulating effects, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Red Clover are attributed to its ability to regulate hormonal imbalances, improve menopausal symptoms, and support bone health.
